_comment: Shared vectors for the TLS trust policy fingerprint (H5). Read by BOTH apps/agent/internal/link/trust_fingerprint_test.go and tests/build/test_tls_pin_fingerprint_contract.py. The server credits an agent as converged only when the fingerprint it reports equals the one the server computes for the advertised policy, so the two implementations agreeing is a security property rather than a nicety: if they drift, every agent reads as unconverged, every rotation has to be forced, and forcing is the stranding the gate exists to prevent. Neither language's suite alone would notice - each would be checking its own arithmetic against itself.
algorithm: sha256(mode + '\x00' + pin), lowercase hex, first 32 chars
